name: Keifa
source:
"No, you are 'Sweet Clown.' ...The one who grants people's wishes."

One of the servants at the Sweet Clown castle, a man a vibrant and lively air.
He's haughty, bold, and confident. 
Because his master often goes outside, he manages everything in the castle instead.
